import os, pathlib, textwrap
root=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689824/attempts/9d615e3a66d9447e8803eb583e82b2e3/system/state/workspace')
programs=root/'programs'; programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The most common color is the canvas. Enclosed rectangular outlines
    # are filled according to the demonstrated interior-size rule.
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    found = set()
    for top in range(h):
        for left in range(w):
            c = grid[top][left]
            if c == bg:
                continue
            for bottom in range(top + 2, h):
                for right in range(left + 2, w):
                    if any(grid[top][x] != c or grid[bottom][x] != c for x in range(left, right + 1)):
                        continue
                    if any(grid[y][left] != c or grid[y][right] != c for y in range(top, bottom + 1)):
                        continue
                    if any(grid[y][x] != bg for y in range(top + 1, bottom) for x in range(left + 1, right)):
                        continue
                    found.add((top, left, bottom, right))
    for top, left, bottom, right in found:
        fill = 2 if (bottom - top - 1, right - left - 1) == (2, 2) else 7
        for y in range(top + 1, bottom):
            for x in range(left + 1, right):
                out[y][x] = fill
    return out
'''
f=programs/'task-df70b7d2.py'; f.write_text(code)
